requirements: Customer-support triage agent: classify incoming tickets, draft replies with citations from the knowledge base, and escalate billing disputes to a human reviewer. 50k tickets/day, every action must be traceable for compliance, p95 first response < 3s.
Conversational FAQ assistant for a SaaS product. Answers must come only from indexed docs; anything else is refused. Small team, minimal ops budget, latencies under 2s per turn.

Deep-research assistant: decompose an open question, search 40+ sources in parallel, cross-check contradicting claims, and produce a cited report with confidence labels. Quality of the final report outweighs token cost.

Literature-screening agent for a research group: screen 5k paper abstracts per run against inclusion criteria, and borderline decisions must be verified by a second, independent reviewer pass before inclusion.

Autonomous code-change agent for a monorepo: read an issue, edit code, run the test suite, and iterate on failures until green or a step budget of 15 tool rounds is exhausted. Unsafe commands must be blocked by a permission layer.

Pull-request review pipeline: one agent summarizes the diff, parallel agents check security, style, and tests independently, and a final reviewer aggregates findings into a single verdict with severity ratings.

Grounded QA assistant over a 2M-document corpus with per-answer citations. Retrieved chunks are graded for relevance and re-queried when insufficient. Hallucinated answers are unacceptable (regulated domain).

Multi-hop question answering over internal wikis, tickets, and spreadsheets: queries are rewritten per hop, results cached per session, and the answer names every source used. Team of 3; keep per-question cost below $0.05.

Incident-triage swarm for a cloud platform: parallel agents parse logs, metrics, and recent deploys; findings are debated to a single root-cause hypothesis; a runbook executor applies mitigation only after a verifier approves it.

Data-analysis agent for analysts: take a natural-language question, plan the SQL queries, execute them against a read replica, verify row counts, and narrate the result. Long-running analyses must survive interruptions and resume.

Trading-signal assistant: generate analysis only, every output passes a compliance check before display, hard kill-switch halts all activity on anomalous behavior, and full decision traces are archived for the auditor.

Content pipeline agent: outline, draft, fact-check, and polish articles in a fixed sequence; each stage transforms the previous stage's output and stores intermediate artifacts so any stage can be re-run independently.
